decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core heat-exchange portfolio, it is inexpensive to keep as an option and there is not yet enough evidence to justify withdrawal.
This condenser fits the established product base, so management would likely keep it on the market while demand uncertainty continues to resolve, despite some risk of later portfolio pruning.

Because it appears very similar to existing condenser offerings, it may face some overlap risk, but the firm is still likely to keep it for now given low continuation cost and limited time since launch.
A liner for corroded tubes strongly complements the firm's service and retrofit business, making it a low-risk extension worth keeping open.
A customized industrial air cooler plays to the firm's strengths in tailored integrated solutions, so the option value of staying in the market remains high.
Repair inserts reinforce the profitable aftermarket and lifecycle-services model, so management would be unlikely to drop them this early.
